title: Lög um ársreikninga nr. 3/2006, 66. gr. d (ófjárhagsleg upplýsingagjöf)
citation: Lög um ársreikninga nr. 3/2006, 66. gr. d, inserted by 42. gr. laga nr. 73/2016 (A-deild 73/2016)
evidence: 42. gr. laga nr. 73/2016: "Á eftir 66. gr. c laganna koma tvær nýjar greinar, 66. gr. d og 66. gr. e ... (66. gr. d.) Ófjárhagsleg upplýsingagjöf." 74. gr.: "Lög þessi öðlast þegar gildi og koma til framkvæmda fyrir reikningsár sem hefst 1. janúar 2016 eða síðar." Signed 2016-06-16, published in Stjórnartíðindi 2016-06-27 (https://www.island.is/stjornartidindi/nr/5b09c253-b6a4-47df-8da2-0f07186d9daf, read through the API on 2026-11-02). The date is the signature date because the clause says only 'þegar'.
notes: Stored text: none. Alþingi Lagasafn (the consolidated text) is blocked from the cloud address (Cloudflare challenge on curl and headless Chromium) and IS-ALTHINGI-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested; the gazette row IS-STJORNARTIDINDI-ADOPTED is permission requested because Höfundalög 9. gr. was not opened on an official page. English: government.is serves unofficial translations (IS-GOVERNMENT-TRANSLATION, permission requested). No CSRD transposition act in the gazette on 2026-11-02: searches of A-deild for ófjárhagslega, sjálfbærniskýrslu and 2022/2464 over 2025 and 2026 returned no act; consultation status on samradsgatt.is and althingi.is could not be opened from the cloud address, so CSRD status stays to confirm. The Alþingi URL is the usual current-text alias and was not opened. Later amendments to 3/2006 include 102/2020 (A-deild), 132/2014 and 14/2013.

title: Markaðssetningarlög nr. 44/2026
evidence: 42. gr. (Gildistaka): "Lög þessi öðlast þegar gildi." Signed 2026-05-07, published 2026-05-15 (A-deild 44/2026, read through the API on 2026-11-02). The date is the signature date because the clause says only 'þegar'.
notes: Stored text: none. English: government.is serves unofficial translations (IS-GOVERNMENT-TRANSLATION, permission requested). Deviation from the brief: lög nr. 57/2005 (eftirlit með viðskiptaháttum og markaðssetningu) are repealed by 42. gr. of this act, so 57/2005 gets no entry; this act is the umbrella for misleading commercial practices (it implements Directive 2005/29/EC and 2019/2161). Its list of implemented acts (41. gr.) does not name Directive (EU) 2024/825, and a search of the gazette for the directive found no separate act, so the 2024/825 transposition is not published on 2026-11-02 and the status stays to confirm.
